title: Fix CAD Edge Hover and Selection Display
description: CAD lines/edges are not showing hover effect or visually selectable. They must also remain visible when on a surface (currently they share the same color as surface hover). Wire CAD plugin selection/hover for edge components like lowpoly, and fix World3d edge overlay colors/depth so edges are distinct from face hover fill.
summary: CAD B-rep edges now hover and select visually. Wired CAD play runtime to round-trip hoveredComponent, selectionMode/componentIds, and edge worldPick (with objectId), matching lowpoly. World3d edge overlays use hovered.lineColor (not face hover fill), draw with depthTest=false, and base edges follow instance line paint so they stay visible on hovered surfaces.
